drivingQuestion: From where do we know betrothal by money, and that the money is the father's?
outcomeNote: Only the questions are posed in this unit; the answers follow in the next sugya.

segments.he: בְּכֶסֶף. מְנָא לַן? וְתוּ, הָא דִּתְנַן: ״הָאָב זַכַּאי בְּבִתּוֹ בְּקִדּוּשֶׁיהָ, בְּכֶסֶף בִּשְׁטָר וּבְבִיאָה״, מְנָלַן דְּמִיקַּנְיָא בְּכֶסֶף, וְכֶסֶף דַּאֲבוּהּ הוּא?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that a woman can be acquired «with money.» The Gemara asks: «From where do we» derive that a woman can be acquired through money? «And furthermore,» with regard to «that which we learned» in a mishna (Ketubot 46b): «A father has authority» over «his daughter with regard to her betrothal,» whether it is «through money, through a document, or through sexual intercourse, from where do we» derive «that» she «is acquired» by her husband «with money, and» that this «money is her father’s?»
